title: Discounts a diver can type
description: A code works across your whole schedule, unlike the one-trip deal you send from a departure. DiveDay creates it on your Stripe account, which enforces the expiry and redemption cap.

notice.created: Code created and live on your Stripe account.
notice.disabled: Code switched off — it stops discounting immediately.
notice.invalid: Check the code, discount, and dates and try again.
notice.invalidCode: A code can use letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores only.
notice.invalidWindow: The end date has to come after the start date.
notice.duplicate: You already have a code with that text.
notice.notConnected: Connect your Stripe account in Settings first — a code is created on your own account.
notice.stripeFailed: Stripe didn't create that code. It's saved as failed here and can't discount anything; try again.
notice.notAuthorized: Promo codes discount real money, so they're limited to owners and managers.
notice.restored: Code re-created and live again on your Stripe account.
notice.restoreFailed: Couldn't restore that code. Create it again below.

connectBanner: Connect your Stripe account in <settingsLink>Settings</settingsLink> before creating a code — codes are created on your own Stripe account, not DiveDay's.

newCode.heading: New code
newCode.detail: Divers type this at checkout. Leave the dates or the cap empty for no limit.

fields.whatForHint: (optional — your note, never shown to divers)
fields.timezoneHint: Times are in {timezone}, your shop's timezone.

empty.heading: No codes yet
empty.detail: Create one above, or send a one-trip deal from a departure's page when a boat needs filling.

redeemedWithCap: {count, plural, one {Redeemed # time of {max}} other {Redeemed # times of {max}}}

tripDeals.heading: Trip deals
tripDeals.description: One-trip discounts sent from a departure's page — the other half of every live code, gathered here so nothing is only visible from the trip it was sent on.
tripDeals.empty: No trip deals are outstanding right now. Send one from a departure's page when a boat needs filling.
tripDeals.recipients: {count, plural, one {Sent to # diver} other {Sent to # divers}}
tripDeals.rangeNote: Trip deals top out at 90% — the boat sails either way, so a deal always leaves something on the table. Shop-wide codes can reach 100% because staff also use them for comps.
